description: An Axum-based Rust web framework with Lean 4-verifiable application kernels that run on servers, bare-metal embedded devices, and GPUs, plus integrated security testing.

written.description: Gives an agent a browser that controls its own network traffic, so the model can capture, edit, replay and compare the requests a web app sends without a proxy in between. Each session runs under a network policy and records every fetch it allowed or refused.

alive.last_commit_message:
h5i-app-h1: prove response heads, whole-body decoding and message bou… (#798)

* h5i-app-h1: prove response heads, whole-body decoding and message boundaries

- write_head_spec: write_head (and open/field/end) writes exactly Spec.renderHead.
- H1Body: Spec.dechunk, feed_dechunk (chunkStep fold = dechunk), dechunk_local.
- read_body moves the body loop out of h5i-app-embedded into h1; H1Read proves
  it matches dechunk, used = start + consumed, w <= r, nothing past used changes.
- H1Prefix: parse_head is stable under extension, so read segmentation does
  not change the result.

Also includes the pending h5i-app-embedded, h5i-app-json and thermostat
example work on this branch.

* h5i-app-embedded: test that read segmentation does not change serve's output

300 seeded streams of pipelined GET, Content-Length and chunked requests,
served whole and with random read sizes; checks identical output, used equal
to each request's wire length, and untouched bytes after each request.

* h5i-app-embedded: retry connect in the embassy-net test

serve_tcp has one listener; between connections it is still closing the last
socket, so the client's second SYN could get a reset (about 1 run in 4).
The client now retries connect, as a client of a single listener must.

* h5i-app-h1: sans-IO receive loop, proven over any split of reads

- recv_step: the receive loop without I/O (parse_head, then read_body; says
  when to read more). carry, fit_limits and must_close move from the shell.
- H1Recv: recv_step_spec; drive_split/drive_at_once (any split of the same
  reads gives the same action, payload and filled); recvS_prefix; drive_room;
  carry_spec/drive_next (the next request starts with exactly the bytes after
  used); fit_limits_spec, must_close_spec.
- h5i-app-embedded's serve is a thin driver: read into rx[filled..] and
  filled += n on NeedRead, otherwise act on the Action.
- READMEs and design docs: the trusted shell is now the read, filled += n,
  timeouts, routing, handlers and the write_field loop.
